title: Koru common definitions
description: Shared building blocks referenced by the other Koru schemas.

semver.description: Semantic version of the Koru contracts the document was produced against (contracts/VERSION).

slug.description: Lowercase identifier: letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.

relativePath.description: POSIX path relative to the document's directory. Absolute paths and '..' segments are forbidden.

oneOf.description: Maps from strategy and simulation games (city builders, 4X, ...).

bbox.description: 2D bounding box [min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y] in the dataset CRS.
